Data Platform / Trading Technology

We are seeking a
**Principal Data Engineer**
to design and build a next-generation proprietary data platform from the ground up at a global leading trading firm. You will create the systems, pipelines and automation needed to ingest, normalise, validate and deliver very large volumes of proprietary and alternative data across HFT, ETFs, options, indices, ecommerce, contracts and M&A.

This is a high-impact, hands-on leadership role. You will work directly with traders, quantitative researchers, engineers and business stakeholders to turn fragmented, complex and often unstructured data into reliable, low-latency, research-ready and trading-ready datasets.

You will combine strong data engineering with automation, Python development and practical use of LLMs and AI agents to accelerate ingestion, extraction, enrichment, classification and data-quality workflows.

**What You’ll Do**

* Define and deliver the technical architecture for a firm-wide proprietary data platform, covering ingestion, storage, transformation, cataloguing, lineage, access and delivery.
* Build high-volume, high-reliability batch and near-real-time data pipelines for market, reference, alternative and proprietary datasets.
* Design pipelines and data models for HFT-related data, including market data, order data, execution data, ETF, options and index data.
* Build data ingestion and enrichment systems for ecommerce, corporate contracts, M&A, filings, news and other unstructured or semi-structured sources.
* Work closely with traders and quants to understand research, alpha, risk, execution and trading-workflow requirements, then translate them into scalable data products.
* Build automated ingestion, parsing, normalisation, deduplication, validation and reconciliation frameworks.
* Develop production-grade Python services, tooling and pipeline components for data extraction, transformation, orchestration and quality control.
* Apply LLMs, embeddings and AI-agent workflows to extract structured information from documents, contracts, filings, web content and other unstructured sources.
* Build automated data-quality, anomaly-detection and lineage frameworks to ensure datasets
* Mentor data engineers and collaborate with infrastructure, quant, trading and software engineering teams.
* Stay hands-on: write code, debug complex pipeline issues, review designs and drive technical decisions.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Significant experience as a Principal, Staff, Lead or Senior Data Engineer, ideally within a trading firm, hedge fund, market maker, fintech or data-intensive technology business.
* Expert-level Python, with a track record of building clean, performant, production-grade data engineering systems.
* Deep experience designing and operating large-scale ETL/ELT pipelines across multiple internal and external data sources.
* Strong SQL and data-modelling skills, with experience across relational, columnar and/or NoSQL databases.
* Experience building data platforms or critical data infrastructure from scratch, rather than only maintaining existing systems.
* Strong understanding of data quality, reconciliation, lineage, metadata, schema evolution and automated validation.
* Experience processing structured, semi-structured and unstructured data, including APIs, files, web data, documents and event streams.
* Practical experience using LLMs or AI/ML techniques for extraction, classification, enrichment, search or workflow automation.

**Desirable Experience**

* Direct experience with financial datasets, including equities, ETFs, options, futures, indices, market data, reference data or alternative data.
* Exposure to HFT, electronic trading, execution, order-book or market-microstructure data.
* Experience with low-latency or high-throughput data systems.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company

The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: CPW Data Steward I
description:

* Pragmatic and solution driven mindset

Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: SAP Consultant
description:
**Hiring: SAP Data Migration Consultant – S/4HANA Finance & Alteryx**

**Industry:**
IT Services & Consulting

**Experience:**
5–8 Years

**Budget:**
Up to ₹25 LPA

**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

**Locations:**
Multiple locations across India

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

We are looking for an experienced
**SAP Data Migration Consultant specializing in SAP S/4HANA Finance and Alteryx**
to support end-to-end financial data migration initiatives for enterprise SAP transformation projects.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in SAP data migration, financial data profiling and cleansing, source-to-target mapping, transformation, SAP S/4HANA migration tools, and financial reconciliation. Strong expertise in Alteryx Designer is essential for building scalable, reusable workflows that ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and auditability throughout the migration lifecycle.

The successful candidate will work closely with SAP Finance functional consultants, business stakeholders, data owners, technical teams, and project management teams to plan and execute migration activities from initial assessment through mock migrations, cutover, reconciliation, and post-migration validation.

**Key Responsibilities :**

**1. SAP S/4HANA Finance Data Migration**

* Lead and execute end-to-end data migration activities for SAP S/4HANA Finance implementations and transformation projects.
* Define migration scope, data objects, migration strategy, timelines, dependencies, and execution plans.
* Coordinate data extraction, profiling, cleansing, transformation, validation, loading, and reconciliation activities.
* Participate in migration workshops with Finance, SAP functional, business, and technical teams.
* Execute mock migration cycles, identify defects, resolve data issues, and support cutover and go-live activities.
* Ensure migrated financial data meets business requirements, data quality standards, and audit expectations.

**2. Finance Data Objects and Mapping**

* Perform source-to-target field-level mapping for SAP S/4HANA Finance data objects.
* Work with financial master data and transactional data, including:
* General Ledger (GL) and Chart of Accounts (CoA)
* Profit Centers and Cost Centers
* Business Partners (BP) and Customer/Vendor Integration (CVI)
* Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP)
* Fixed Assets and Asset Accounting
* Tax-related master data
* Bank master data and related financial information
* Analyze source-system structures, target-system requirements, mapping rules, transformation logic, and dependencies.
* Collaborate with SAP Finance functional teams to resolve mapping gaps, data inconsistencies, and business-rule exceptions.
* Understand relevant SAP data structures and tables, including ACDOCA, BKPF, BSEG, SKA1, SKB1, LFA1, LFB1, KNA1, and ANLA.

**3. Alteryx Data Profiling, Cleansing and Transformation**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize Alteryx Designer workflows for large-scale data migration activities.
* Perform data profiling, parsing, cleansing, standardization, validation, deduplication, fuzzy matching, joins, pivots, and transformation.
* Build reusable and parameterized workflows, macros, and mapping tables to support repeatable migration cycles.
* Implement data quality rules, exception handling, reference-data management, and validation checks.
* Identify missing values, duplicate records, inconsistent formats, invalid master data, and other migration risks.
* Optimize workflow performance and implement appropriate logging, traceability, and data lineage practices.
* Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to improve data quality before loading data into SAP S/4HANA.

**4. SAP Migration Cockpit and Data Loading**

* Execute data loads using SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, including staging-table or direct-transfer approaches where applicable.
* Understand migration object templates, source structures, mapping requirements, dependencies, and load sequencing.
* Prepare and validate migration files or staging data before loading.
* Monitor migration execution, analyze error logs, troubleshoot failed records, and coordinate defect resolution.
* Reprocess corrected records and validate successful loading into the target SAP environment.
* Support mock loads, dress rehearsals, production cutover, and post-go-live data validation.
* Work with SAP functional and technical teams to resolve loading errors and migration object issues.

**5. Financial Reconciliation and Data Validation**

* Perform pre-migration and post-migration reconciliation to confirm the accuracy and completeness of migrated financial data.
* Reconcile trial balances, General Ledger balances, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, fixed assets, and bank-related data.
* Validate record counts, financial balances, debit/credit totals, opening balances, and key control totals.
* Investigate reconciliation differences and coordinate corrective actions with Finance and SAP teams.
* Prepare reconciliation reports, migration sign-off documentation, issue logs, and audit-ready evidence.
* Ensure migration results meet agreed acceptance criteria and financial control requirements.

**6. Migration Planning, Cutover and Stakeholder Coordination**

* Develop migration plans, mock-cycle schedules, cutover checklists, issue trackers, and reconciliation templates.
* Coordinate migration dependencies across Finance, SAP functional, technical, data, and business teams.
* Track migration progress, data quality metrics, defects, risks, and outstanding dependencies.
* Support go/no-go assessments, cutover rehearsals, production migration, and stabilization activities.
* Maintain clear documentation of mapping rules, transformation logic, data quality findings, load results, and reconciliation outcomes.
* Communicate migration status, risks, and remediation plans to project stakeholders.

**Required Technical Skills :**

**SAP S/4HANA Finance**

* Hands-on experience in SAP data migration, preferably for SAP S/4HANA Finance.
* Strong understanding of Finance master data and transactional data migration.
* Knowledge of GL, CoA, Profit Centers, Cost Centers, Business Partners/CVI, AR/AP, Asset Accounting, Tax, and Bank Master data.
* Familiarity with SAP tables such as ACDOCA, BKPF/BSEG, SKA1/SKB1, LFA1/LFB1, KNA1, and ANLA.
* Practical experience with SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, migration objects, load sequencing, error resolution, and reconciliation.

**Alteryx Designer**

* Strong hands-on proficiency in Alteryx Designer for data preparation and migration.
* Experience building reusable workflows and macros.
* Proficiency in data profiling, cleansing, joins, parsing, deduplication, fuzzy matching, regular expressions, and pivoting.
* Understanding of data quality rules, mapping tables, reference data, logging, lineage, and workflow optimization.

**Data and Reconciliation**

* Strong SQL skills for data extraction, validation, and analysis.
* Advanced Excel skills for mapping, reconciliation, data validation, and reporting.
* Ability to investigate data discrepancies, resolve migration defects, and maintain accurate documentation.

**Experience and Qualifications :**

* 5–8 years of relevant SAP data migration experience.
* Experience delivering 1–2 full-cycle SAP S/4HANA Finance migration projects.
* Demonstrated hands-on experience in migration planning, data mapping, transformation, loading, reconciliation, and cutover.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

**Good to Have :**

* Experience with SAP BODS, SAP MDG, or SAP CPI.
* Exposure to Alteryx Server and enterprise workflow management.
* Basic knowledge of SAP Ariba supplier and purchase-order data.
* Experience with SAP ECC-to-S/4HANA migration or multi-system consolidation.
* Familiarity with data governance, financial controls, and audit documentation.

**Work Locations:**

Hybrid opportunities are available across the following Indian locations, subject to project requirements and team allocation:

* **Maharashtra:**
  Navi Mumbai (Mahape), Mumbai (One BKC, Andheri East), Pune (Hinjawadi, Baner), Nagpur (MIHAN SEZ)
* **Tamil Nadu:**
  Chennai (SIPCOT IT Park, Pallavaram, Ascendas IT Park), Coimbatore (Vetrivel Tower, India Land Tech Park)
* **Karnataka:**
  Bengaluru (Prestige Shanthiniketan, North Square, BCIT SEZ), Mangalore
* **Uttar Pradesh:**
  Noida (Sector 135)
* **Telangana:**
  Hyderabad (Prestige Sky Tech)
* **Gujarat:**
  Ahmedabad (Privilon), Gandhinagar (GIFT City)
* **Madhya Pradesh:**
  Bhopal (Maple High Street)
* **Uttarakhand:**
  Dehradun (Doon IT Park)

Interested?

If interested, please apply through the job posting below or email your resume to hr@stafingo.com for immediate consideration.

We look forward to connecting with experienced SAP Data Migration professionals who can deliver reliable, accurate, and audit-ready S/4HANA Finance migration outcomes.

title: Data Operations - Private Markets, Vice President, Investment Management
description:
**Vice President, Data Operations — Private Markets**
Morgan Stanley Investment Management (MSIM) is one of the largest global asset management organizations of any full-service securities firm, with more than 50 years of history, a presence in 26 countries, and a total of $2 trillion in assets under management as of June 30, 2026.
  
  
MSIM provides broad-based specialization across a range of asset classes in public and private markets. Our independent investment teams leverage Morgan Stanley’s global resources to serve a diverse client base of governments, institutions, corporations, advisors and individuals worldwide. Our investment solutions include a broad range of alternatives, high-conviction active strategies, customization strategies, ESG expertise and tax management solutions. For further information about Morgan Stanley Investment Management, please visit www.morganstanley.com/im.
  
  
MSIM is at an important point in the evolution of its data capabilities. As a global investment manager with significant scale, continued growth, an increasingly diverse investment platform, and growing demand for data, analytics, and AI, we have a compelling opportunity to reimagine how data is organized, governed, architected, and consumed across the firm.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced Vice President, Data Operations — Private Markets to play a critical role in advancing the data operating model across MSIM's Private Markets platform. The role will be responsible for establishing and operating governance and controls over data received from external fund administrators and internal platforms, helping ensure that critical investment and operational data is complete, accurate, timely, traceable and fit for use across the organization.
  
  
The Vice President, Data Operations will work across Operations, Investment teams, Technology, Data Governance, Finance, Risk and external service providers to translate business processes and data requirements into practical governance, data quality and control frameworks. The role will establish clear accountability for data, drive consistent standards across sources and platforms, and help ensure that data issues are identified, understood and remediated as close to source as possible.
  
  
This is an opportunity to help shape how Private Markets manages data as the platform continues to scale and modernize. The successful candidate will combine a strong understanding of Private Markets operations with data governance expertise, a rigorous control mindset and the ability to influence across business, technology and external partners. The role will help move the organization from fragmented and manually intensive data processes toward a more standardized, transparent and exception-driven operating model.
  
  
The successful candidate will help create an operating environment in which Private Markets data is easier to understand, govern, trust and consume. They will establish practical governance over critical data elements, data quality, ownership, lineage and issue management while maintaining the controls and accountability expected within a regulated financial institution. This role requires someone who can operate at both the strategic and execution levels—helping define the target operating model while remaining sufficiently close to the data and underlying business processes to ensure governance standards translate into practical outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Establish and operate data governance and quality frameworks for critical Private Markets data received from fund administrators, third-party providers and internal platforms.
* Define and maintain Critical Data Elements (CDEs), data ownership, business definitions, sourcing requirements and data quality standards across key Private Markets data domains.
* Own data quality oversight, including completeness, accuracy, timeliness and consistency controls, exception management, issue tracking and remediation governance.
* Drive root-cause analysis and sustainable remediation of data issues, partnering with fund administrators and internal data providers to address recurring issues at source.
* Establish and maintain business data lineage and traceability across critical data flows, from source through transformation and downstream consumption.
* Develop data quality rules, tolerances and preventative controls that reflect underlying business processes, materiality and downstream data usage.
* Partner with Technology and Data Governance on data onboarding, platform enhancements, governance tooling and implementation of scalable data-quality capabilities.
* Develop KPIs and management reporting covering data quality, timeliness, exceptions, remediation and recurring issues, using trends to drive continuous improvement.
* Represent Private Markets Data Operations in relevant governance forums and partner with stakeholders across Operations, Investment teams, Finance, Risk, Technology and other consumers of Private Markets data.
* Contribute to the continued development of the Private Markets Data Operations operating model, including increased automation, exception-based processing and clear accountability across global teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 10–14+ years of experience in investment management, financial services or a similarly complex data environment, with meaningful experience in Data Operations, Investment Operations, data governance or related functions.
* Strong understanding of Private Markets data and operating processes, ideally across private equity, private credit, real estate, infrastructure and other alternative investment strategies.
* Experience working with data supplied by fund administrators, third-party service providers and internal investment, accounting or operational platforms.
* Practical experience establishing or operating data governance and data quality frameworks, including CDEs, data ownership, business definitions, lineage, data quality rules, issue management and controls.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate complex data issues, identify root causes and drive sustainable remediation across organizational and external-provider boundaries.
* Strong understanding of operational controls and experience operating within a regulated financial-services environment.
* Experience partnering with Technology and data teams to translate business requirements into scalable data processes, controls and platform capabilities.
* Familiarity with Private Markets and fund accounting platforms such as eFront, Investran or comparable platforms is preferred.
* Familiarity with enterprise data governance, cataloguing and data-quality tooling and modern data platforms is beneficial.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with demonstrated ability to influence across business, technology and external partners.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Business, Information Systems, Data Management or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

**Who You Are**

* Operates with a strong sense of ethics and integrity in interactions with others and decision making.
* Takes accountability and ownership with a focus on delivering sustainable, long-term outcomes.
* Brings a strong control mindset and applies sound judgment when managing data quality issues and exceptions.
* Collaborates across teams and organizational boundaries to deliver effective solutions.
* Combines attention to detail with the ability to understand broader business processes and data dependencies.
* Pursues continuous improvement and operational modernization, challenging existing processes constructively.
* Communicates clearly, translating complex data and operational issues into business implications and actions.
* Commits to developing others and contributing to a collaborative, high-performing team environment.

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.

Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**About Business Line/Function**
The AML IT function sits within the BNP Paribas Corporate & Institutional Banking (CIB) CEFS‑technology ecosystem and provides end‑to‑end technology platform that enables the bank’s anti‑money‑laundering (AML) program. Its core purpose is to translate regulatory and compliance requirements into robust, scalable, and secure IT solutions that detect, investigate, and report suspicious activity across the Group’s global operations.
  
  
The AML IT business line is the technology backbone that transforms raw transaction data into actionable AML intelligence, ensuring that BNP Paribas CIB meets its regulatory obligations while maintaining operational resilience and innovation.
  
  
**Position Purpose**
The AML platform is the technological backbone that protects BNP Paribas Group from fraud, money‑laundering and other financial crimes. As a Senior Data Engineer you will design, build and operate high‑performance, Python services that ingest, enrich, analyze and surface AML‑relevant data. You will work side‑by‑side with data‑scientists, compliance experts and other engineers to translate regulatory requirements into reliable code.
  
  
Direct AML experience is not mandatory; strong end to end data pipeline development experience, Python, SQL expertise, a proven record of delivering large‑scale data‑intensive systems and the ability to pick up AML concepts quickly are essential.
  
  
**Direct Responsibilities**

* Develop & deliver production‑grade Python micro‑services, event‑driven workers and APIs (FastAPI/Django/Flask, Celery, asyncio) that process millions of transactions per day with low latency.
* Build data pipelines using PySpark, Apache Beam or similar frameworks; integrate with streaming platforms (Kafka, Pulsar) and batch ingestion layers.
* Collaborate with data‑science teams to package, serve and monitor ML models for anomaly detection, transaction clustering and network analysis.
* Implement data‑quality, lineage and privacy controls (GDPR/CCPA) throughout ingestion‑to‑case‑management flows.
* Write automated tests, CI/CD scripts and IaC (Terraform/CloudFormation) to ensure repeatable, safe releases.
* Perform code reviews, mentoring and knowledge‑sharing to uplift junior developers and enforce Python best‑practice standards.
* Monitor, troubleshoot and optimize services in production using observability stacks (ELK, Grafana, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry) and profiling tools (Dynatrace, Py‑Spy, cProfile).
* Participate in feasibility studies for emerging technologies (graph databases, stream‑ and produce concise evaluation artefacts for the AML Architecture Committee (ITSVC).
* Implement end to end data orchestration with proper data modeling.
* Document architectural decisions, API contracts and data‑flow diagrams to keep the AML platform aligned with the target‑state design.

**Technical And Behavioral Competencies**

* Expert‑level knowledge on Python, async programming, libraries: FastAPI/Django/Flask, Celery, Pandas, NumPy, PySpark.
* Should be able to design, develop and secure REST/GraphQL services; event‑driven patterns (Kafka, Pulsar).
* Should be able to build/optimize ETL/ELT pipelines; experience with Spark/Flink
* Strong knowledge on SQL (PostgreSQL, Oracle) and NoSQL/graph (Neo4j, JanusGraph) – modelling, indexing, performance tuning.
* Production experience on Docker, Kubernetes (helm charts), serverless functions.
* Hands on experience on Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions; IaC (Terraform, CloudFormation); automated testing (pytest, unittest).
* Should be able to write logging, metrics & tracing using (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).
* Should have awareness of Secure coding, OAuth2/JWT, data‑privacy (GDPR/CCPA.
* Should have ability to articulate technical concepts to both technical and compliance audiences; strong written documentation skills.
* Proven experience in globally distributed Agile squads; mentor junior team members.
* Ability & willingness to learn & work on diverse technologies (languages, frameworks, and tools)

**Nice To Have Skills**

* Exposure to ML frameworks (Scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) and model‑deployment pipelines.
* Familiarity with AML‑specific open‑source tools (SAR‑ML, OpenAML, custom rule engines).
* Knowledge of AML regulatory reporting standards (FAT, 5AMLD, FinCEN).
* Cloud‑architect certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, Google Professional Cloud Architect)

Education Level: Bachelor Degree or equivalent
  
  
Experience Level: At least 7 years
  
  
**About BNP Paribas India Solutions**
Established in 2005, BNP Paribas India Solutions is a wholly owned subsidiary of BNP Paribas SA, European Union’s leading bank with an international reach. With delivery centers located in Bengaluru, Chennai, and Mumbai, we are a 24x7 global delivery center. India Solutions services three business lines: Corporate and Institutional Banking, Investment Solutions and Retail Banking for BNP Paribas across the Group. Driving innovation and growth, we are harnessing the potential of over 10000 employees, to provide support and develop best-in-class solutions.
  
  
**About BNP Paribas Group**
BNP Paribas is the European Union’s leading bank and key player in international banking. It operates in 65 countries and has nearly 185,000 employees, including more than 145,000 in Europe. The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking & Services for the Group’s commercial & personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment & Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate & Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. Based on its strong diversified and integrated model, the Group helps all its clients (individuals, community associations, entrepreneurs, SMEs, corporate and institutional clients) to realize their projects through solutions spanning financing, investment, savings and protection insurance. In Europe, BNP Paribas has four domestic markets: Belgium, France, Italy, and Luxembourg. The Group is rolling out its integrated commercial & personal banking model across several Mediterranean countries, Turkey, and Eastern Europe. As a key player in international banking, the Group has leading platforms and business lines in Europe, a strong presence in the Americas as well as a solid and fast-growing business in Asia-Pacific. BNP Paribas has implemented a Corporate Social Responsibility approach in all its activities, enabling it to contribute to the construction of a sustainable future, while ensuring the Group's performance and stability
  
  
**Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
At BNP Paribas, we passionately embrace diversity and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees are valued, respected, and can bring their authentic selves to work. We prohibit Discrimination and Harassment of any kind, and our policies promote equal employment opportunity for all employees and applicants, irrespective of, but not limited to their gender, gender identity, sex, sexual orientation, ethnicity, race, color, national origin, age, religion, social status, mental or physical disabilities, veteran status etc. As a global Bank, we truly believe that inclusion and diversity of our teams is key to our success in serving our clients and the communities we operate in.

**Role: IBM BPM Developer/BAW Developer**

**Location: Goregaon East, Mumbai (local candidates only)**

**Job Type: Fulltime**

**Experience: 2+ years**

**Budget: Upto 9 LPA**

**Immediate to 30 Days notice only**

**Job Overview**

We are seeking an experienced and highly skilled IBM BPM / BAW Developer with a strong background in Java/JEE enterprise application development and relational databases. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing end-to-end process automation workflows.

A critical component of this role involves utilizing IBM Integration Designer (IID) to build Advanced Integration Services (AIS), BPEL processes, and mediation flows that bridge our workflow engine with complex enterprise backend systems. The ideal candidate will bridge the gap between process modelling (Process Designer) and complex backend enterprise integration (IID/Java/SQL).

**Key Responsibilities**

1.
**Process Automation & Workflow Development**

* Design, develop, and implement end-to-end process models using IBM Business Automation Workflow (BAW) / IBM BPM (Process Designer).
* Create and maintain standard/advanced client-side human services, coach views, and custom UI components using JavaScript/CSS.
* Implement complex process logic, tracking groups, timers, gateways, and UCA (Undercover Agents) event handling.

2.
**Advanced Integration & Middleware (IID)**

* Utilize IBM Integration Designer (IID) to develop robust Advanced Integration Services (AIS), Service Component Architecture (SCA) modules, and BPEL (Business Process Execution Language) processes.
* Design and configure custom Mediation Flows, data transformations (XSLT/BO Maps), and adapters (JDBC, Flat File, Web Services) within IID.
* Build, expose, and consume secure corporate enterprise web services (REST APIs and SOAP/WSDL protocols) using XML and JSON data mapping.

3.
**Java Stack & Core Backend Customization**

* Develop custom server-side plugins, integration components, and utility classes using Core Java / JEE to handle complex business logic outside standard out-of-the-box BPM capabilities.
* Write clean, maintainable enterprise Java code, managing object mappings, dependency injection, and advanced multithreaded processing configurations.

4.
**Database & Performance Optimization**

* Write complex, high-performance SQL queries, stored procedures, triggers, and functions to interact with enterprise relational databases (e.g., Oracle, IBM DB2, or MS SQL Server).
* Design data schemas and optimize database interactions within BPM integration services to minimize latency and avoid process blocking.

The Pipeline TD is responsible for developing and maintaining software tools, providing front-line support to artists, and general troubleshooting of the CG pipeline in a fast-paced, feature film visual effects production environment. * Work primarily on tools of a high degree of complexity, requiring broad understanding of the larger pipeline.
* Assist junior Pipeline TDs in providing front-line support; resolve complex user errors; guide Pipeline Engineers and R&D with debugging technical issues.

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science or a related technical field.
* Demonstrated experience developing and maintaining tools for use in a computer graphics environment.

* Proficiency in Linux

* Ability to communicate cross-discipline and provide innovative solutions to pipeline issues.
* Detail oriented and strong self-sufficient troubleshooter.
* Thorough understanding of the entire visual effects process, from shooting to modeling and texturing, animation, rendering and compositing

* Experience with production database systems
* Experience with C, C++

title: EY - GDS Consulting - AI And DATA - Semantic BI - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics - Semantic BI Engineer – Senior**
EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY's financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY's Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalise on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client's decision-making.
  
  
**Role : Semantic BI Engineer**
**Experience Guide : 3-7 Years**
**Primary Skill Area :**
Semantic Analytics, Self-Service BI, Dashboards, AI-Enabled Insights & Decision Intelligence
  
  
**The opportunity**
Design, build and advise on enterprise BI and semantic analytics solutions that convert trusted data into actionable business insights. This role is not limited to dashboard development; the candidate must be able to assess business needs, propose the right dashboarding or self-service reporting tools, design semantic data layers, build high-quality dashboards, and enable next-generation AI-assisted analytics experiences. The role combines analytics engineering, semantic layer design, dashboard architecture, BI strategy, data storytelling, data modelling, AI enablement and strong business analysis capability.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* BI Strategy, Tool Evaluation & Solution Advisory
* Assess business reporting, analytics and self-service consumption needs across user personas, maturity levels, governance requirements and operating constraints.
* Evaluate and recommend the right BI, dashboarding and self-service reporting tools based on scalability, semantic layer fit, governance, cost, user adoption, integration capability and AI-readiness.
* Shape enterprise BI and analytics roadmaps across Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst and other modern analytics platforms.
* Advise stakeholders on when to use operational reporting, executive dashboards, self-service analytics, semantic search, conversational BI, embedded analytics or AI-assisted insight discovery.
* Semantic Layer & Analytics Engineering
* Design semantic data layers that separate business logic from physical data structures and allow consistent consumption across dashboards, reporting tools, AI assistants and self-service analytics platforms.
* Define governed business metrics, KPIs, measures, dimensions, hierarchies, calculations, data definitions and reusable analytical entities.
* Develop analytics engineering assets using SQL, dbt-style transformation patterns, Fabric semantic models, Power BI datasets, lakehouse/warehouse tables and curated analytical data products.
* Align semantic models with business glossaries, metadata, lineage, data quality rules, access controls and enterprise governance standards.
* Dashboard Development, Architecture & Data Storytelling
* Design and develop high-quality dashboards, scorecards and analytical reports that support executive decisions, operational monitoring, root-cause analysis and business performance tracking.
* Apply dashboard design principles including KPI hierarchy, drill-through, guided navigation, narrative flow, visual consistency, usability, accessibility and performance optimisation.
* Build dashboards using tools such as Power BI, Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst or equivalent enterprise BI platforms.
* Move beyond visualisation by translating patterns, trends and exceptions into actionable business insights, recommendations and decision support.
* Data Modelling, Data Analysis & Insight Generation
* Apply strong data modelling skills including dimensional modelling, star schema design, semantic modelling, analytical data product modelling, metric modelling and data mart design.
* Perform deep data analysis using SQL, analytical thinking, data profiling, reconciliation, segmentation, trend analysis, variance analysis and root-cause investigation.
* Partner with business SMEs, data engineers, data architects and product owners to convert business questions into robust data models, analytical logic and reusable reporting assets.
* Ensure insights are grounded in trusted data, explainable logic, meaningful context and clear business interpretation.
* AI-Enabled Analytics & Next-Generation BI
* Understand where and how AI can improve analytics workflows, including natural language querying, automated insight generation, anomaly detection, narrative summaries, semantic search and guided analysis.
* Enable AI-assisted analytics using capabilities such as Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure AI Foundry and Azure OpenAI where relevant.
* Design AI-ready semantic layers that provide business context, trusted metrics, governed definitions and explainability for conversational BI and agentic analytics use cases.
* Identify appropriate use cases for AI in BI while recognising where traditional dashboards, governed reports or human-led analysis remain more suitable.
* Governance, Adoption & Analytics Operating Model
* Define governance standards for dashboards, semantic models, KPIs, certified datasets, access controls, refresh schedules, lifecycle management and reporting asset ownership.
* Support integration with governance and catalogue platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Snowflake Horizon, Immuta or equivalent enterprise tools.
* Create templates, design standards, dashboard review checklists, documentation patterns and adoption playbooks for consistent analytics delivery.
* Enable business users through self-service analytics training, guardrails, metric definitions and trusted data consumption practices.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* BI and dashboarding - Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Qlik, Databricks AI/BI, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, executive dashboards, self-service reporting, embedded analytics.
* Semantic and analytics engineering - Semantic layers, Fabric Semantic Models, Power BI datasets, metrics layer, governed KPIs, SQL, dbt-style modelling, analytical data products, business glossary alignment.
* Data modelling - Dimensional modelling, star schema design, snowflake schema design, semantic modelling, metric modelling, data mart design, canonical/domain model awareness, data dictionary creation.
* Data analysis and insight generation - Advanced SQL, data profiling, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, variance analysis, segmentation, data storytelling, business analysis, actionable insight generation.
* AI and next-generation analytics - Fabric Copilot, Power BI Copilot, Databricks Genie, Snowflake Cortex Analyst, ThoughtSpot Spotter, Azure OpenAI, conversational BI, semantic search, AI-assisted insights, agentic analytics.
* Governance and operations - Microsoft Purview, Collibra, Unity Catalog, Immuta, certified datasets, data lineage, access controls, dashboard governance, BI adoption, performance optimisation.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Relevant experience guide: 3-7 years
* 3+ years of experience in BI, analytics engineering, data analysis, semantic modelling, data modelling or analytics architecture.
* Strong hands-on experience developing dashboards and semantic models, with the ability to advise on the right BI/self-service analytics tools for business needs.
* Preferred certifications: Power BI Data Analyst, Microsoft Fabric Analytics Engineer, Tableau, Snowflake/Databricks analytics credentials, AI/GenAI foundations or cloud data certifications.

**Ideally, you'll also have**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.
* This role is not a traditional BI Developer. It is a Semantic BI Engineer and analytics architect who defines how trusted data is modelled, consumed and converted into actionable insight through governed dashboards, self-service analytics and AI-enabled decision intelligence.

**What We Look For**

* Architect by mindset, not only dashboard developer by nature; able to influence BI strategy and analytics consumption architecture.
* Excellent data analytics, stakeholder management, business consulting and data storytelling skills.
* Understands where AI should and should not be used in analytics workflows, and can guide business users towards trusted, governed and actionable insights.
* Comfortable operating across business, analytics, data engineering, semantic architecture, AI and enterprise governance teams.

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we're dedicated to helping our clients, from start-ups to Fortune 500 companies, and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasises high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that's right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Engineer - AI (Mining Automation)
description:
**Job Description**
WSP is seeking an Engineer AI (Mining Automation) to join the GCC Specialist Mining Services team, supporting the delivery of digital and automation solutions for global mining projects. Reporting to the Mining Automation Team Leader, the successful candidate will develop and implement AI-enabled workflows that improve the way mining, asset, operational, geotechnical, and technical information is processed, connected, analysed, and used for engineering decision-making.
  
  
The role combines mining-domain understanding with artificial intelligence, automation, data engineering, computer vision, knowledge extraction, and graph-based retrieval. The Engineer will collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across WSP to develop practical, scalable, traceable, and responsible solutions for mine planning, operations, tailings and water management, asset performance, risk management, and engineering delivery.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**AI and Mining Automation Development**

* Design, develop, and implement AI-enabled automation solutions for mining engineering and operational workflows.
* Work with mining specialists to identify high-value automation opportunities and convert technical requirements into practical digital solutions.
* Develop intelligent workflows that integrate geological, geotechnical, mine planning, operational, asset,

environmental, and risk information.
  
  

* Support the use of generative AI, machine learning, computer vision, and agent-based approaches to improve engineering productivity and decision support.
* Create reusable components and scalable solution patterns that can be applied across global mining projects.

**Data Extraction and Document Intelligence**

* Develop automated pipelines to extract information from mining reports, PDFs, scanned documents, drawings, tables, figures, inspection records, and monitoring outputs.
* Apply OCR, layout understanding, multimodal models, and LLM-based techniques to identify entities, attributes, relationships, measurements, risks, and supporting evidence.
* Implement validation, normalization, exception-handling, and quality-control logic to improve the accuracy and consistency of extracted information.
* Maintain traceability between extracted outputs and the relevant source documents, pages, figures, tables, or evidence.

**AI Models and Advanced Analytics**

* Develop, validate, and support deployment of machine learning solutions for predictive analytics, anomaly detection, classification, risk assessment, optimization, and asset insights.
* Apply data science and statistical methods to identify patterns, trends, and actionable insights from engineering and operational data.
* Evaluate model performance, limitations, and suitability for mining use cases, working with domain experts to confirm engineering relevance.
* Contribute to proof-of-concept development and the transition of successful prototypes into maintainable production solutions.

**Knowledge Management and Graph-Based Intelligence**

* Support the design of structured knowledge models that connect mining assets, technical information, operational data, risks, controls, and engineering evidence.
* Contribute to knowledge graph and semantic data solutions using RDF, OWL, SPARQL, or equivalent technologies where appropriate.
* Develop graph-native and hybrid retrieval workflows, including GraphRAG approaches that combine structured graph context with AI models.
* Enable natural-language access to connected mining knowledge for engineering assistants, analytics tools, and decision-support applications.
* Support provenance, versioning, evidence linking, and auditability of AI-generated or graph-derived outputs.

**Cloud, Data, and Platform Integration**

* Develop and integrate solutions using Azure AI services, Azure OpenAI, Azure Machine Learning, Azure AI

Document Intelligence, and related cloud capabilities, where applicable.
  
  

* Build and maintain data pipelines, APIs, connectors, and services that integrate AI workflows with engineering platforms and enterprise data environments.
* Contribute to deployment, monitoring, documentation, testing, and continuous improvement of production AI applications.
* Support MLOps, prompt and model evaluation, access control, data security, and responsible AI practices.

**Global Project Delivery and Collaboration**

* Work as part of the GCC Specialist Mining Services team to support multidisciplinary mining assignments delivered across WSP's global business.
* Collaborate with the Mining Automation Team Leader, mining engineers, geotechnical specialists, tailings

practitioners, data scientists, software developers, and digital teams.
  
  

* Engage with project and domain teams to understand technical context, refine use cases, review outputs, and align solutions with project requirements.
* Communicate technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across different regions and time zones.
* Prepare solution documentation, specifications, test records, user guidance, and knowledge-transfer materials.
* Contribute to internal standards, reusable assets, lessons learned, innovation initiatives, and capability

development within the team.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Education**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mining Engineering, Computer Science, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence,

Software Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Technical Experience And Skills**

* Experience developing AI, machine learning, automation, data analytics, or document intelligence solutions in

mining, engineering, infrastructure, industrial, or asset-intensive environments.
  
  

* Proficiency in Python and experience with relevant AI, data science, or machine learning libraries and frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation, or generative AI application development.
* Knowledge of data engineering concepts, ETL or ELT pipelines, APIs, structured and unstructured data processing, and system integration.
* Experience with OCR, document processing, computer vision, layout analysis, or multimodal AI techniques.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Azure-based AI and data services.

**BGV:**

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

**About Us**
WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation & Infrastructure, Property & Buildings, Earth & Environment, Power & Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
With approximately
**4,000 talented people**
across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru & Mumbai offices) in India and more than
**73,000 globally**
, in 550
**offices across 40 countries**
, we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
  
  
At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
**Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**

***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***

You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.

description:
**Job Description:**
**About Us**
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. We do this by driving Responsible Growth and delivering for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
  
  
Being a Great Place to Work and providing a culture of caring is core to how we drive Responsible Growth. We are intentional about fostering an inclusive workplace where every teammate has the opportunity to succeed, build a career and contribute to our shared success. This includes attracting and developing exceptional talent, recognizing and rewarding performance, and supporting our teammates’ physical, emotional, and financial wellness through affordable, competitive and flexible benefits.
  
  
We value the unique perspectives individuals bring from all backgrounds and career paths - whether shaped by military service, community college education, or a wide range of work and life experiences. These journeys foster resilience, leadership and innovation, strengthening our workforce and positively impact the communities we serve.
  
  
Bank of America is committed to an in-office culture that supports collaboration, engagement, and career development. Our approach includes clear in-office expectations, while providing an appropriate level of flexibility based on role-specific responsibilities and business needs.
  
  
At Bank of America, you can build a successful career with opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact. Join us!
  
  
**Global Business Services**
Global Business Services delivers Technology and Operations capabilities to Lines of Business and Staff Support Functions of Bank of America through a centrally managed, globally integrated delivery model and globally resilient operations.
  
  
Global Business Services is recognized for flawless execution, sound risk management, operational resiliency, operational excellence and innovation.
  
  
In India, we are present in five locations and operate as BA Continuum India Private Limited (BACI), a non-banking subsidiary of Bank of America Corporation and the operating company for India operations of Global Business Services.
  
  
**Process Overview\***
CFO Data Management India team was set up in 2023 as a part of the CFO Global Delivery strategy to provide offshore delivery to CFO Data Management, part of Enterprise CFO functions, consolidating legacy functions of Finance Data Management and Treasury Data Management. The capabilities hosted include Data Analysis, Product specialists with understanding of underlying Data for Regulatory Reporting, Reconciliations, Management Reporting & Analysis, Research & Analytics, Financial Transaction Processing and Finance Systems Support
  
  
Data Management team enables the Finance Organization and supports data needs of finance business users.
  
  
The Data Management team engages in various activities (including, but not limited to):
  
  

* Regulatory Reporting related data management Activities: Team support activities related to US Regulatory reports, data validation and resolution of Data quality issues.
* Team performs a critical role in providing centralized support for products such as Loans, Deposits, Derivatives, Cards etc. Data Quality/Validation and analysis for internal and external regulatory reporting.
* Team is engaged in activities such as validation of data for regulatory reports, data quality issue resolution, data reconciliation with authoritative sources and posting adjustments. Team actively works on strategic initiatives aimed at improving the quality of numbers reported in regulatory reports.
* Data Sourcing and provisioning: This includes defining and implementing data provisioning strategy to source the data from all lines of business into regulatory reports and management reports. Team is actively involved in sourcing initiatives where it works with various source systems, technology teams and report owners to source the data into regulatory reports as per regulator and stakeholder requirements.

**Job Description\***
Supporting Global Regulatory Reporting team to enrich the regulatory reporting by performing Daily, and Monthly Data Controls and Reconciliations to cover data Gaps and needs to perform set of controls for reference data management at product and reference data level. Built and test Data controls on SQL and implement via Alteryx. Data controls and data validations and reconciliations are to achieve a greater control on data prior the submission of regulatory reports to regulators.
  
  
The role will involve collaborating with multiple onshore business partners across the bank to understand different reporting systems. The candidate will be required to understand the regulatory reports and need to proactively engage with the onshore change management and technology teams responsible for improving our data quality and assist efforts on feed development / enhancement and overall process design to close the gaps identified. Also, the candidate should have advanced level of Alteryx and SQL knowledge to work on process enhancement and automations.
  
  
**Responsibilities\***

* Monthly/Daily production run of DQ/DV control checks for US Reporting
* Perform root cause analysis of data gaps and drive remediation
* Understand, explore and achieve the scope of automation and remediation after coordinating with downstream and upstream stakeholders like middle office, finance operation and other related business functions
* Engagement with Global Regulatory Reporting and Product’s SME and other stakeholders to discuss the new requirements via intake forms and to understand the new requirements along with the expansion on validation and analytical process.
* Partnering with external and internal auditors to drive the soundness and successfully execution of internal control programs
* Reconciliation of GL balances with Data sources for identifying gaps and drive resolution
* Engage with business and technical stakeholders at varied levels to align on key objectives and provide data control oversight and proactively escalate and mitigate risks, and ensure adherence to applicable regulators and policies
* Design and Development of data controls
* Work with business partners to expand data quality/data validation and analytical processes
* Visualize data gaps using Tableau

**Requirements\***
**Education\***
**BE/B Tech./MCA/ MBA Finance Or Equivalent Qualifications**
Certifications If Any NA
  
  
**Experience Range\***
0-3 years of Techno-Functional experience in Finance/Banking domain with SQL/Alteryx/Tableau experience.
  
  
**Foundational skills\***

* Basic understanding of Regulatory reporting
* Intermediate/Basic SQL knowledge
* Intermediate/Basic Alteryx/Tableau knowledge
* Experience in driving change process/ re-engineering & automations
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* Flexibility to deal with multiple concurrent issues and tasks - ability to self-manage and prioritize
* Problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making abilities
* Dynamic, high energy, solid work ethic, willing to take on initiatives.
* Able to excel and influence in a cross-functional team structure.
* Flexibility and good negotiations skills

**Desired Skills**

* Basic knowledge of Ui Path/ Python

**Work Timings\***
9 hours shift between 11 AM and 11 PM

Mumbai / Gurugram

title: Implementation Analyst
description:
Reporting To:
  
  
Associate Director, Implementation

About Russell Investments, Mumbai:
  
  
Russell Investments is a leading outsourced financial partner and global investment solutions firm providing a wide range of investment capabilities to institutional investors, financial intermediaries, and individual investors around the world. Building on an 90-year legacy of continuous innovation to deliver exceptional value to clients, Russell Investments works every day to improve the financial security of its clients. The firm is “Top 12 Ranked Consultant (2009-2024)” in P&I survey 2024 with $1,013 billion in assets under advisement (as of June 30, 2026) and $417.5 billion in assets under management (as of June 30, 2026) for clients in 30 countries. Headquartered in Seattle, Washington in the United States, Russell Investments has offices around the world, including London, New York, Toronto, Sydney, Tokyo, Shanghai, and Mumbai.
  
  
Joining our Mumbai office means becoming part of a globally connected team where associates collaborate across functions, geographies, and time zones to support the work of a globally recognized asset management firm. Based in Goregaon (East), you will have the opportunity to work alongside colleagues around the world, contribute to meaningful initiatives, and build your career in a collaborative and inclusive environment. The Mumbai office operates with varying shifts to support collaboration across global time zones.
  
  
For more information, please visit https://www.russellinvestments.com.
  
  
Job Description:
  
  
**About The Role**
Russell Investments is seeking a highly analytical, technology-minded Portfolio Implementation Analyst to join our Mumbai-based team supporting the fast-growing Personalized Managed Accounts (PMA) business. This role sits within a global portfolio management team responsible for implementing systematic, tax-aware and personalized investment strategies across client accounts.
  
  
You will support daily portfolio implementation, optimization, trade preparation and data validation while helping improve the systems and processes that make the business scalable. The strongest candidates will be comfortable working across multiple systems, investigating issues, using data to form a view, and translating problems and enhancement ideas into clear recommendations for portfolio managers, business partners and developers.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Support daily portfolio implementation, including account optimization, trade creation and review, compliance checks, cash management, data validation and exception resolution.
* Analyze optimizer results and portfolio data to identify unusual outcomes, data-quality issues, system defects and opportunities to improve decision rules or workflows.
* Work across investment, trading, risk, data and operational systems; determine whether breaks originate from data, configuration, process or technology and drive issues toward resolution.
* Use SQL, Excel and other analytical tools to query, reconcile and validate data, support root-cause analysis, and reduce manual checks where practical.
* Identify and help implement automation opportunities that improve accuracy, control, speed and scalability, including thoughtful use of AI and emerging technologies.
* Translate business problems into clear requirements: articulate the issue, impact, evidence and recommended enhancement to peers, managers and developers; support testing and implementation.
* Coordinate with global portfolio management, trading, operations, research and technology teams on trades, cash activity, account events and implementation issues.
* Interpret and process security corporate actions and help resolve security master, pricing and other market-data exceptions across a large security universe.
* Document procedures, controls, recurring issues and findings; manage multiple priorities, execute directions accurately, and escalate material issues with concise analysis and recommended next steps.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 3-5 years of experience in investment management, portfolio operations, trading, investment technology, data analysis or a related field.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. A master’s degree, CFA progress/designation or other relevant qualification is beneficial but not required.
* Strong understanding of capital markets, investment portfolios, asset classes and/or performance measurement, combined with rigorous analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated comfort working with multiple systems and large data sets, including the ability to recognize when something does not look right, investigate why, and recommend a practical response.
* Working knowledge of SQL and strong Excel skills. Experience with Python, Power BI or other data/automation tools is a plus.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a problem, its business impact and a recommended solution to both investment professionals and technology teams.
* Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively; a self-starter who takes ownership, asks questions early and is candid when a concept, process or requirement is unclear.
* Strong organization, attention to detail and time management, with the ability to execute instructions consistently and accurately in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort making pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, documenting the rationale, and adjusting as new information becomes available.
* Curiosity, strong work ethic and a continuous-improvement mindset; willing to challenge the status quo constructively and look for better ways to work.

**Preferred Experience**

* Retail or institutional trading, portfolio management, portfolio implementation or portfolio optimization.
* Axioma Portfolio or another portfolio optimization/risk platform; Bloomberg or similar market-data tools.
* Security-level corporate actions, security master/reference data, pricing data and exception resolution across a broad security universe.
* System testing, requirements gathering, process design, workflow automation or partnership with software developers and technology teams.
* Using AI or emerging technologies to streamline analysis, documentation, controls or investment workflows.
* Tax-managed investing, direct indexing or separately managed accounts is helpful, but prior U.S. tax-management experience is not required.

How You’ll Work
  
  
This is a hands-on role in a rapidly growing business. You should be comfortable moving quickly, learning continuously and taking ownership from the outset. We value people who are direct, curious and dependable; who ask good questions rather than make silent assumptions; who can make a reasonable decision with incomplete information and explain their reasoning; and who actively look for opportunities to make the portfolio-management process more efficient, scalable and robust.
  
  
Why Join PMA?
  
  

* Join one of Russell Investments’ strategic growth businesses and help shape how a scaled, technology-enabled portfolio-management platform evolves.
* Gain exposure to global portfolio management, trading, optimization, risk, investment operations and technology while working with experienced investment professionals across regions.
* Build a career at the intersection of investing, data and technology, with meaningful opportunities to take ownership as the business and platform expand.
* Have visible impact: strong ideas, thoughtful analysis and effective automation can improve client outcomes and the way the team operates from day one.Portfolio Implementation Analyst

title: Analyst, Global Programs Support
description:
The Program Analyst is a full-time role combining rigorous impact metrics data validation and executive reporting with hands-on project management support. This role is the team's data custodian: every piece of data that flows into the master database is expected to be reviewed, challenged, and validated before it is accepted. Alongside this, the Analyst works closely with Contract Performance Managers (CPMs) on a daily basis, helping translate scattered project information into clean, approval-ready project deliverables, and acts as the team's tracker — keeping CPMs on schedule for milestones, payments, timely deliveries and approvals. The ideal candidate brings a strong audit background, an exacting eye for detail, and confident PowerBI, Excel, PowerPoint and MS Project (Gantt chart) skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Data Validation & Database Integrity**

* Act as the primary gatekeeper for all data entering the master databases — reviewing, cross-checking, and challenging inputs submitted by CPMs before acceptance. All data across CPMs’ working files and Program Support master databases need to be consistent and accurate.
* Apply a rigorous, audit-style validation process to impact metrics evidence, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and alignment with reporting standards and evidencing frameworks.
* Maintain high Excel hygiene across all working files — clean formulas and data input, version control, and structured, auditable workbooks including standardising SharePoint folders.
* Flag inconsistencies or gaps to CPMs or Program Leader, follow up to resolution, and maintain a clear log for internal tracking and validation
* Build and maintain Gantt charts in MS Project to track project timelines, dependencies, and milestones.
* Proactively prompt CPMs ahead of approaching deadlines, milestone payments, and approval document requirements, helping the team stay focused and on track for each project's next stage. Escalate risks to deadlines or deliverables in good time.
* Support proactive project oversight by maintaining real-time visibility of project risks and E2E issue indicators. Escalate issues requiring management attention to safeguard program performance and KPI delivery.
* Continuously enhance operational processes by identifying gaps in data entry and validation workflows and addressing them through automation and process improvements.

**2. Reporting, Dashboards & Executive Presentation**

* Independently gathers, synthesises, and verifies information from diverse sources to produce reliable content.
* Build, maintain, and refresh PowerBI dashboards to support internal and external reporting needs.
* Prepare and tightly edit PowerPoint materials for internal and external audiences, ensuring wording and formatting meet executive-level standards.
* Support both internal reporting (Project Steering Committees, Program calls) and external reporting (Governing Council and Leadership Board) with a consistent level of polish and rigor. All data provided at internal and external forums need to be consistent with PowerBI, accurate and current.
* Support and coordinate the India Program Advisory Group (PAG) meetings under the guidance of Program Strategy and Engagement Leader, ensuring PowerPoint materials and minutes are approved and circulated on time
* Support meeting governance through accurate and timely minute-taking, capturing key discussions, decisions, action items, and ownership to ensure accountability and effective follow-up.

**3. Project Management Support**

* Support CPMs with day-to-day project management activities, acting as an extra pair of hands across the project lifecycle, and ensure CPMs adhere to project deadlines and comply to the E2E process during pipeline development or project execution.
* Support CPMs in drafting project deliverables (e.g. change requests, executive summary, closure reports etc.) by consolidating scattered or incomplete information into clean, submission-ready drafts.
* Liaise with CPMs to clarify missing information and ensure deliverables are internally consistent and fulfils the E2E process criteria before they are routed for approval.
* Review invoices and deliverables and promptly submit disbursement requests; troubleshoot any challenges related to Microsoft Business Central (BC).
* Maintain regular engagement with CPM’s and Program Workstream Leaders to share relevant updates and ensure alignment on information that could affect project execution and program objectives.
* Support pipeline development, project execution documentation and other ad-hoc project administration as needed. This includes documentation and collection of information to expedite the E2E process, and working closely with the Funding Recipient to obtain information or follow up on outstanding matters.
* Support internal and external audit processes of the projects and programs, through collection and consolidation of relevant information and documents, and providing data analysis and justification as needed.
* Participate in site visits and support related preparation work as needed.
* Support any other responsibility as relevant to the job description, emerging from time to time.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field
* 3+ years of relevant work experience.
* Prior experience in an audit, assurance, or controls-focused role strongly preferred — comfortable challenging data and evidence rather than taking it at face value.
* Advanced Excel skills with excellent file hygiene and a strong data-oriented mindset.
* Working experience with PowerBI (dashboard building and maintenance) required.
* Strong PowerPoint skills — able to produce tight, polished, executive-ready slides.
* Experience with MS Project or equivalent Gantt-chart tools.
* Prior exposure to project coordination or project management support is highly valued.
* Excellent attention to detail, follow-through, and stakeholder communication skills.
